class.name: TrainDieselEngine
class.brief_description: Diesel engine handler class, for vehicles with a mechanical transmission (gearbox, optional torque converter and retarder).
class.description: Class handling diesel engines with a mechanical transmission. Vehicles with an electric transmission ([code]EngineType=DieselElectric[/code]) should use [TrainDieselElectricEngine] instead, which extends this class with the electric-transmission-specific FIZ fields (and [member wwlist]).

members.member: [code]Engine:EDS[/code] Gearbox clutch disengagement rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:EUS[/code] Gearbox clutch engagement rate, in 1/s.
[code]Cntrl.FuelStart[/code]
[code]Engine:nmax_cutoff[/code] Engine speed at which the fuel cutoff limiter activates, in RPM.
[code]Engine:IsRetarder[/code] Whether the vehicle has a retarder.
[code]Engine:IsTC[/code] Whether the vehicle has a hydraulic torque converter.
[code]Engine:AIM[/code] Moment of inertia of the engine/shaft.
[code]Engine:nmax[/code] Maximum engine speed, in RPM.
[code]DList:Mnmax[/code] Torque at maximum RPM, in Nm.
[code]DList:Mmax[/code] Maximum torque, in Nm.
[code]DList:nMmax[/code] Engine speed at maximum torque, in RPM.
[code]Engine:nmin[/code] Minimum engine speed, in RPM.
[code]DList:NomFuelConsRate[/code] Nominal fuel consumption rate at full power, in g/kWh.
[code]DList:nominalfill[/code] Nominal (rated) fuel dose, dimensionless (0..1).
[code]Cntrl.OilStart[/code]
[code]Engine:OilMaxPressure[/code] Minimum oil pressure required for the engine to start
[code]Engine:OilMinPressure[/code] Minimum oil pressure required for the engine to start
[code]Cntrl.WaterStart[/code]
[code]DList:Mstand[/code] Engine's own resistance torque at zero RPM, in Nm.
[code]Engine:R_FRD[/code] Retarder emptying (fill decrease) rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:R_FRI[/code] Retarder filling rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:R_MP[/code] Retarder maximum power, in kW (also limits torque).
[code]Engine:R_MT[/code] Retarder maximum torque, in Nm.
[code]Engine:R_MinVel[/code] Minimum velocity at which the retarder operates, in km/h.
[code]Engine:R_Place[/code] Where the retarder is placed within the transmission.
[code]Engine:R_TII[/code] Retarder torque constant proportional to the square of input RPM.
[code]Engine:TC_CP[/code] Relative speed at which the torque converter transitions into fluid-coupling mode.
[code]Engine:TC_FRD[/code] Torque converter emptying rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:TC_FRI[/code] Torque converter filling rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:TC_LR[/code] Torque converter lockup clutch engagement rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:TC_LS[/code] Velocity threshold at which the lockup clutch engages.
[code]Engine:TC_LT[/code] Maximum torque of the torque converter's lockup clutch, in Nm.
[code]Engine:TC_TMMax[/code] Maximum torque multiplication ratio of the torque converter.
[code]Engine:TC_TII[/code] Torque converter constant proportional to the square of input RPM, in Nm/(rps)².
[code]Engine:TC_TIO[/code] Torque converter constant: input-output coupling, in Nm/(rps).
[code]Engine:TC_TOO[/code] Torque converter constant proportional to the square of output RPM, in Nm/(rps)².
[code]Engine:TC_ULR[/code] Torque converter lockup clutch release rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:TC_ULS[/code] Velocity threshold at which the lockup clutch releases.
[code]DList[/code] Throttle table: for each throttle position (starting from 0), the fuel dose and clutch/governor behavior.

[code]HTCList[/code] Torque converter's torque-ratio table. Recommended when the converter's real characteristic is known and cannot be reproduced with the basic formula. Each item's [member CurvePointItem.x] is the output/input RPM ratio and [member CurvePointItem.y] is the torque multiplication ratio.
[code]DMList[/code] Linearly-interpolated engine torque curve. Each item's [member CurvePointItem.x] is engine speed in RPM and [member CurvePointItem.y] is torque in Nm.
